product_metadata.title: Kitinjoy Luxury Bathroom Rug Mat, Super Soft Water Absorbent Microfiber Bath Rug, Non Slip Plush Shaggy Bath Carpet, Machine Wash Dry, Bath Mats for Bathroom Floor, Tub and Shower, 24 x 47, Black
features: [PLUSH ENOUGH FOR COMFORT] Our fluffy bathroom shower rugs are made of premium thick microfiber fabric for optimal softness you can see and feel! You will love them feels like walking on a cloud. Every time you step out of the shower or bathtub, you can enjoy superior comfort. In addition, each fabric batch is also tested for various durability features such as water absorption, softness, color fastness etc, individually inspected to be defect free and finally packed for sales.

[ULTRA ABSORBENT] Thanks to upgraded new premium Microfiber fiber material, our bath rug can quickly absorb the water and keep floors clean and dry. As we professionally tested, it can absorb 14 times of water in few seconds.

[UPGRADED NON SKID BATH RUGS] Upgraded TPR backing make this rug is totally non-slip and durable, providing protection for your family whenever it is used. Do not place mat on wet surface. Make sure floors are dry underneath the rug to prevent the rug from slipping.

[WEll MADE TECHNIQUE] Unique fiber-locking technique makes the fluff more thicker, the dense pile is also not easy to fall off than other bath mats from other brands. Designed in simple geometry patterns and in neutral colors, this bathroom carpet can go with different kinds of decor style, you can easily find one to fit in front of the single or double sinks, showers, bathtubs, vanities and more.

[MACHINE WASH & DRY] Kitinjoy bathroom rug is easy to clean. Machine washed in cold water with a mild detergent which does not contain chlorine or bleach, then hang it in a ventilated or sunny place to keep dry. Color will not fade and stay vibrant for many time washing and drying. Our shower rugs will be a great gift idea for all occasions, Christmas, Wedding, Fathers Day, Mothers Day, Valentines.
